newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka tenders to buy Jan diesel,jet and petrol.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka tenders to buy Jan diesel,jet and petrol.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued two tenders for the purchase of diesel, jet fuel and gasoline, industry sources said on Friday.
The first tender seeks 185,000 barrels of 1.0-percent sulphur diesel and 40,000 barrels of jet fuel for delivery to Colombo between January 23-24.
The second tender seeks 185,000 barrels of 1.0-percent sulphur diesel and 85,000 barrels of 85 to 88-octane leaded gasolinefor delivery to Colombo between January 29-30.
Both tenders close on January 8 and are valid until January 9, traders said.

CPC bought its last 1.0-percent sulphur diesel at a premium of $1.57 per barrel to Singapore spot quotes, while the jet fuel was bought at a $1.77 per barrel premium to Singapore spot quotes, both on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Colombo for delivery between January 15-16.

Traders said the increase in CPC's diesel purchases from two cargoes a month to three cargoes was due to the scheduled shutdown of a 50,000-60,000-barrel per day refinery for maintenance from mid-January.
